title: ASCEP Capacity Report (envelope)
description: The complete machine-readable capacity report. Binding constraints: C1 complete declaration (nulls allowed, never omissions), C2 provenance tags on every numeric claim, C3 topology binding, C4 context binding, C5 binding constraint on every capacity row, C6 all four tiers, C7 gates pre-declared, C8 reproduction bundle. A report meeting C1-C5 but not C6-C8 MAY be labelled 'partial'.

ascep_version.description: Protocol version the report was produced under. Reports MUST cite it; cross-version comparison of numbers requires the majors to match.

conformance.description: conforming = C1-C8; partial = C1-C5 met, some of C6-C8 not; non-conforming reports MUST NOT be compared against conforming ones.

serving.description: Layer 3 declaration; provides the topology triple binding all downstream numbers (C3).

run.description: Layer 4 declaration and results; provides the pre-declared gates (C7).

workload.description: Layer 5 declaration; capacity is a function of all five layers — an envelope without workload numbers is a partial capacity statement.

capacity_tiers.description: C6: all four tiers MUST be present. They differ by integer multiples; reporting one tier alone is non-conforming because readers assume the most favourable.

theoretical.description: Roofline tier (T): bandwidth-bound decode via ascep.capacity.roofline_decode_tok_s; FLOP-bound prefill via roofline_prefill_ttft_s. Always an upper bound.

tier.description: Pinned: this row IS the theoretical tier. Copying another row here and forgetting to relabel it is the one way to make the four tiers disagree silently.

measured.description: Best observed tier (M), SLO ignored, via ascep.capacity.capacity_at(tier=Tier.MEASURED).

tier.description: Pinned: this row IS the measured tier. Copying another row here and forgetting to relabel it is the one way to make the four tiers disagree silently.

sustainable.description: Measured restricted to points where every SLO gate held for the full window; capacity_at(slo_pass=false) maps to Constraint.SLO.

tier.description: Pinned: this row IS the sustainable tier. Copying another row here and forgetting to relabel it is the one way to make the four tiers disagree silently.

recommended.description: sustainable ÷ headroom via capacity_at(headroom=...). The row MUST record its headroom factor.

tier.description: Pinned: this row IS the recommended tier. Copying another row here and forgetting to relabel it is the one way to make the four tiers disagree silently.

roofline_comparison.description: roofline_efficiency = measured ÷ theoretical and MUST be reported. A value at or above 1.0 indicates measurement error (mis-declared active_params or an untracked cache hit) and MUST be investigated, not published.

decode_tok_s_measured.description: Best measured aggregate decode throughput, tokens/s (M), bound to context and topology (C3/C4).

roofline_efficiency.description: measured ÷ theoretical, dimensionless. Values above ~0.8 warrant verification; >= 1.0 MUST NOT be published unexamined.

roofline_efficiency_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when roofline_efficiency is null (C1).

prefill_ttft_s_theoretical.description: ascep.capacity.roofline_prefill_ttft_s output, seconds (T); excludes queueing, so real TTFT is always larger.

prefill_mfu_used.description: mfu argument passed to roofline_prefill_ttft_s; typical 0.3-0.5.

decode_tok_s_theoretical_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when decode_tok_s_theoretical is null (C1).

decode_tok_s_measured_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when decode_tok_s_measured is null (C1).

prefill_ttft_s_theoretical_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when prefill_ttft_s_theoretical is null (C1).

prefill_ttft_s_measured_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when prefill_ttft_s_measured is null (C1).

prefill_mfu_used_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when prefill_mfu_used is null (C1).

scaling.description: Per-topology scaling table. Every row restates the topology (C3).

output_tok_s.description: Aggregate tokens/s at this topology and context (M). Units: tokens/s.

context_tokens.description: Context length this throughput was measured at (C4). Units: tokens.

scaling_efficiency.description: ascep.capacity.scaling_efficiency output, dimensionless. A value above 1.0 means the NARROW baseline was degraded (typically KV-starved), NOT superlinear scaling; it MUST be flagged, never celebrated.

efficiency_over_one_explanation.description: REQUIRED whenever scaling_efficiency > 1.0: the concrete reason the baseline was degraded.

context_tokens_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when context_tokens is null (C1). A scaling row without a context length is C4-incomplete and MUST say so here: throughput ratios are only comparable at equal context.

sizing_result.description: Application sizing: users → tokens → GPUs, per ascep.capacity.gpus_required, which rounds UP to whole replicas because capacity is bought in whole tensor-parallel groups.

gpus_required.description: Smallest GPU count meeting the workload at peak, whole replicas. Units: devices.

gpus_required_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when gpus_required is null (C1).

replica_topology.description: Replica layout, e.g. '4 x TP2'. Topology-independent claims are C3 failures.

binding_constraint.description: Which floor binds (C5). Without it the GPU count does not say what to buy more of: 'kv' means buy memory/kv pool, 'throughput' means buy compute, 'slo' means the hardware fits but misses a latency gate.

headroom_factor.description: Headroom divisor used for the recommended tier (gpus_required default 1.15). MUST be stated; recommended figures from different headrooms are not comparable.

utilization_at_target_pct.description: Expected utilization at the target peak load, percent.

utilization_at_target_pct_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when utilization_at_target_pct is null (C1).

headroom_remaining.description: Spare capacity beyond target at provisioned fleet, dimensionless ratio.

floor_crossover_context_tokens.description: Context length in tokens where the binding floor switches from throughput to KV. MUST be stated, or explicitly recorded null with the reason 'not determined' — the crossover changes with context length.

floor_crossover_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when floor_crossover_context_tokens is null (C1).

provenance.description: Tag for the sizing numbers (C2); gpus_required is typically (I) and MUST name ascep.capacity.gpus_required.

replica_topology_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when replica_topology is null (C1).

binding_constraint_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when binding_constraint is null (C1).

headroom_factor_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when headroom_factor is null (C1).

headroom_remaining_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when headroom_remaining is null (C1).

floor_crossover_context_tokens_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when floor_crossover_context_tokens is null (C1).

unmeasured_assumptions.description: §7 of the report: every (U) in this document, its blast radius, and its closure cost. A report whose conclusion flips on an unmeasured number MUST say so here in the same words a reviewer would use.

field.description: Dotted path of the (U) field it backs, e.g. 'workload.peak_to_mean'.

impact_if_wrong.description: Concrete consequence; if it flips a conclusion (tier, binding constraint, GPU count), say which.

cost_to_measure.description: What it would take to close the assumption.

reproduction.description: C8 reproduction bundle. Any missing artefact makes the report at best 'partial'.

run_configs_path.description: Path to the exact run configs.

analysis_script_path.description: Path to analysis notebook/script producing this report's (I) values.

run_configs_path_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when run_configs_path is null (C1).

raw_records_path_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when raw_records_path is null (C1).

engine_logs_path_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when engine_logs_path is null (C1).

environment_capture_path_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when environment_capture_path is null (C1).

analysis_script_path_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when analysis_script_path is null (C1).

container_digest_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when container_digest is null (C1).

conformance_note.description: Which conformance rules are met and which are not, and why. A level claimed without a stated reason is unreviewable: the reader cannot tell a careful partial from a careless one.

capacityRow.description: One capacity tier row, mirroring ascep.capacity.Capacity. binding_constraint is MANDATORY on every row (C5): a capacity figure without its constraint does not say what to buy and is not actionable.

tier.description: Tier (C6); MUST match the envelope key it sits under.

max_concurrent_users.description: Supportable peak concurrent users = min(KV floor, throughput floor), never the average (capacity_at). Units: users.

max_concurrent_users_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when max_concurrent_users is null (C1).

max_tokens_per_s.description: Aggregate output tokens/s at this tier (capacity_at.max_tokens_per_s). Units: tokens/s.

max_tokens_per_s_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when max_tokens_per_s is null (C1).

max_requests_per_s_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when max_requests_per_s is null (C1).

daily_requests.description: Capacity.daily_requests: requests/day IF peak load were sustained around the clock — a headroom figure, deliberately not de-rated by peak_to_mean. Units: requests/day.

binding_constraint.description: Binding floor per ascep.capacity.Constraint (C5): weights = does not fit usefully; kv = memory-bound at this context; throughput = compute-bound; slo = fits on average but misses a declared gate.

n_gpus.description: GPU count this row was computed or measured at (C3). Units: devices.

headroom.description: Headroom applied, as a DIVISOR: capacity is divided by it, so 1.15 means 15 percent held back and 1.0 means none. Same quantity and same direction as sizing_result.headroom_factor. Required and > 1 only for the recommended tier; 1.0 elsewhere. Reading it as a multiplier inverts the correction and inflates the recommended tier by its square.

context_tokens.description: Context length this capacity is valid at (C4). Units: tokens. Interpolated context values MUST cite ascep.capacity.interpolate_throughput and project beyond the measured range only with tag (U).

provenance.description: Row-level tag (C2). (I) rows MUST name the ascep.capacity function that produced them (capacity_at, gpus_required, roofline_decode_tok_s, ...).

produced_by.description: Named source for (I)/(T) rows (C2). 'other' MUST be explained in unmeasured_assumptions.

daily_requests_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when daily_requests is null (C1).

binding_constraint_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when binding_constraint is null (C1).

headroom_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when headroom is null (C1).

context_tokens_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when context_tokens is null (C1).

produced_by_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when produced_by is null (C1).
